invented.why: The brief does not mention who is responsible for reporting, a program officer, or any specific reporting schedule, page length, or deadlines.

invented.quote: Our first-year target is to collect at least 9,000 pounds of farm produce, the amount we turned down last summer, by September 30, 2027.
invented.why: The brief does not give a target date of September 30, 2027, and instead asks to say the van will double the amount of fresh food handed out in the first year.

invented.quote: We will report the pounds collected each quarter. If we fall short of the target, our report will say by how much, why, and what we are changing.
invented.why: The brief says nothing about quarterly reporting or what the reports will contain if the food bank falls short of a target.

invented.quote: a refrigerated van is the only way we can accept it.
